items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Per 3.1.4 and 4.3(d), loss of or damage to property taken away by a third party is not covered, and personal belongings (clothing, jewellery) are not insured property under this buildings policy. The theft occurred away from the insured location and involved movable property, which is explicitly excluded.

Per 5.2.5 and 4.3(e), any expenditure connected with a conveyance (vehicle) is not an insured cost, and vehicles and their costs are not insured property under this policy. The policy does not cover vehicle-related costs under any head.
